name: btp-drawio-skill
description: Generate, validate, score, and render SAP BTP Architecture Center-style draw.io diagrams.
long_description: Local MCP server and CLI wrapper for the BTP draw.io skill. It exposes SAP template scaffolding, deterministic semantic rendering, validation, scoring, rendering, relabeling, and icon extraction tools backed by the bundled SAP Architecture Center-style templates and assets.

tools.name: btp_drawio_scaffold
tools.description: Copy the closest SAP reference template to a destination .drawio file.

tools.name: btp_drawio_render_semantic
tools.description: Render a deterministic SAP-style semantic fallback diagram.

tools.name: btp_drawio_validate
tools.description: Validate a .drawio file for SAP style and structural issues.

tools.name: btp_drawio_score
tools.description: Score a .drawio file against the bundled SAP reference corpus.

tools.name: btp_drawio_render
tools.description: Export a .drawio file using the draw.io desktop CLI.

tools.name: btp_drawio_relabel
tools.description: Apply deterministic label replacements to a scaffolded .drawio file.

tools.name: btp_drawio_extract_icon
tools.description: Emit a ready-to-paste mxCell for a SAP BTP service icon.

python_command.title: Python command
python_command.description: Python executable used to run the bundled skill scripts.

drawio_cli.title: draw.io CLI path
drawio_cli.description: Optional path to draw.io desktop CLI for PNG/SVG/PDF export.
